aspects.name: Display Technology
aspects.desc: Primary medium and technology chosen to realize facade/media art; determines resolution, brightness, viewing angles, and interactivity.

options.name: LED wall panels
options.desc: Outdoor-grade LED panels with scalable resolution and high brightness for building facades.

options.name: Projection mapping
options.desc: Multi-projector setup projecting onto architectural surfaces for flexible geometry.

options.name: Smartphone-distributed screens
options.desc: Content distributed to attendees' devices to form a participatory display network.

options.name: AI-driven kinetic light sculpture
options.desc: Dynamic light sculpture using actuated elements to create moving light geometries.

options.name: Laser-beam architecture
options.desc: Directed laser/beam-based lighting to form lines and patterns on the surface.

aspects.name: Urban Context
aspects.desc: Physical placement within the city, influencing audience reach, access, and regulatory constraints.

options.name: Public plaza/square
options.desc: Open urban space with high pedestrian flow; scheduling must consider safety.

options.name: Transit hub/station
options.desc: High-visibility corridor with commuters; focus on legibility and timing.

options.name: Retail frontage / department store
options.desc: Facade integration with retail environment and brand storytelling.

options.name: Cultural district / museum precinct
options.desc: Cultural setting enabling experimental and curatorial framing.

aspects.name: Interaction Model
aspects.desc: Mode of audience engagement and participation.

options.name: Passive viewing
options.desc: No direct input; audience experiences are curated by designers.

options.name: Audience input via devices
options.desc: Content influenced by user input through mobile devices or sensors.

options.name: Live performer input
options.desc: Performers or operators actively steer visuals in real-time.

options.name: Sensor-driven reactive
options.desc: Visuals respond to crowd movement, ambient data, or environmental sensors.

aspects.name: Content Theme
aspects.desc: Narrative or thematic content expressed by the work.

options.name: Fashion/events
options.desc: Themes around fashion, retail, nightlife, and event aesthetics.

options.name: Public life / daily life
options.desc: Urban life, street activity, and social interactions.

options.name: Art/sculpture
options.desc: Abstract or figurative art forms and sculpture-inspired visuals.

options.name: City data visualization
options.desc: Dynamic visualization of city metrics, datasets, or live feeds.

options.name: Biophilia / wellbeing
options.desc: Nature-inspired patterns and environments aimed at wellbeing.

aspects.name: Temporal Strategy
aspects.desc: Timing and duration of content presentation.

options.name: Day/night adaptive
options.desc: Content adapts to daylight and ambient light levels.

options.name: Event-based
options.desc: Schedule aligned with events, seasons, or performances.

options.name: Long-running / ongoing
options.desc: Persistent installation with evolving visuals over time.

options.name: On-demand viewer selection
options.desc: Viewers choose sequences/content via interface.

aspects.name: Data & Content Governance
aspects.desc: Sources and governance of content used in visuals.

options.name: Open city datasets
options.desc: Utilize publicly available city datasets for visualization.

options.name: Partner-provided data
options.desc: Collaborations with institutions providing datasets.

options.name: Public input with moderation
options.desc: Incorporate community content with moderation.

options.name: Sensor/anonymized data
options.desc: Use anonymized sensor data to protect privacy.
